policy.title: Points and rewards
policy.description: What each kind of work is worth in this academy.
policy.following_defaults: This academy has not set its own values yet, so it follows the platform defaults shown below.

field.grace_minutes: Minutes after the start still on time
field.cap: Most one student can earn in one class in one day

hint.solve: Paid once per problem, the first time a student solves it. A hard problem should be worth more than an easy one, or the numbers tell a student to avoid hard problems.
hint.finish: Paid once, when the last piece is done — every material in a lecture, every lecture in a module, every module in a course.
hint.attendance: Paid once a day, per class, and proved by working rather than by opening a tab. A student gets one of these two, never both.
hint.grace_minutes: Minutes, not points. After this, the day counts as late.
hint.learning_time: Counted minutes, in one class, in one day. Each step pays when it is reached, so a student who studies through all three is paid all three.
hint.cap: The most one student can earn in one class in one day. Without it the ranking measures how long a student sat there, not what they learned.

policy.capped_warning: {{names}} pays more than the daily limit of {{cap}}P, so a student receives the limit instead of the full amount.
policy.forward_only: Changes apply from now on. Points already earned keep the value they were given.
